recipes.title: Apple Prune Fiber Friendly Purée
recipes.age_note: Smooth purée, no honey: fine from 6 m.

ingredients: 1/2 cup apple, peeled, cored, and chopped
source.storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days. Freeze in small containers for up to 2 months.
source.summary: A smooth apple and prune purée with no added sweetener.
tips: Keep a small container of soaked, softened prunes in the fridge to speed up prep.

recipes.title: Asian Pear Rice Congee Purée
recipes.age_note: Blended rice and pear, strained for 6-7 m: fine.

collection_reasons.first-tastes: Simple rice and pear purée from 6 m

flags: Catalog diet tags miss gluten-free; rice, pear and water are gluten-free.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons short grain white rice, rinsed
1/2 cup ripe Asian pear, peeled, cored, and chopped
source.storage: Refrigerate promptly in shallow covered portions and use within 1–2 days; freeze up to 1 month. Discard food left at room temperature over 2 hours. Reheat leftovers to 165°F, then cool before serving.
source.summary: This gentle Asian style rice porridge purée blends soft rice with sweet pear. Parents will like the simple ingredient list and how well it works for breakfast or a light dinner.
tips: Prepare congee as part of family breakfast, then blend a portion for baby to reduce extra cooking.
Thin leftovers with a little warm water when reheating, since rice thickens in the fridge.

recipes.title: Banana Avocado Breakfast Purée with Yogurt
recipes.age_note: Mashed and strained; yogurt fine from 6 m, recipe warns against cow's milk as a drink.

ingredients: 1/2 medium ripe banana, peeled and sliced
1/4 medium ripe avocado, peeled and pitted
2 tablespoons plain, unsweetened, pasteurized whole milk yogurt
1–2 tablespoons breast milk or prepared formula for thinning (optional)
source.storage: Refrigerate untouched leftovers promptly in a covered container for up to 24 hours; press plastic wrap directly on the surface to reduce browning. Stir well before serving and discard if color or smell changes.
source.summary: This creamy breakfast bowl brings together banana, avocado, and yogurt. Parents will like the no-cook method and quick prep on busy mornings.
tips: Use a fork with a wide base for faster mashing when mornings feel busy.
Mix the purée right before serving, since avocado darkens over time even in the fridge.

recipes.title: Comforting Sweet Potato Lentil Khichdi Purée
recipes.age_note: Blended smooth, oil only for 9 m+: fine.

1/2 cup sweet potato, peeled and chopped into 1/2 inch cubes
1/2 teaspoon olive oil (optional, for older babies)
source.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 1–2 days; freeze up to 1 month. Reheat leftovers to 165°F, then cool before serving.

tips: Prepare a double batch and freeze in small portions so you have quick lunches and dinners ready.
Label each container with the cooking date so you rotate older portions first.
